english.title: Offer to supply unclassified video under false indication
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), offer to supply a video recording containing a video work, namely **(..SPECIFY TITLE OF VIDEO WORK..), in respect of which no classification certificate had been issued and
(A)_[the video recording]_
(B)_[a spool on which the recording was kept]_
(C)_[a case in which the recording was kept]_
(D)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY MEDIA TYPE..), on or in which the recording was kept]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(1) and (5) of the Video Recordings Act 1984.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See the Video Recording (Labelling) Regulations 1985 for requirements as to labels for video recordings.
(ii) Time limit for prosecution - either within three years of the commission of the offence of within one year of its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier (Section 15(1)).
(iii) See Section 11(1) and (2) for exemptions and defences and Sections 2 and 3 for definitions of 'exempted work' and 'exempted supply'.
(iv) See also Section 14A for general defences.
(v) See Sections 16A and 16B for extended powers of enforcing authorities and extended jurisdiction of magistrates' courts.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
